prompt: Create a complete high-fidelity desktop WEB GUIDE INDEX comp for End of Abyss Guide, edge-to-edge 1440x1000 landscape, no browser window or device mockup. Direction: cinematic scene editing translated into quiet web reference publishing, not a literal movie bench. True near-black #101617, restrained burned-orange #d08043 in one broad functional guide-selection zone, warm white #f4f4eb type, muted green #5b786c. The product is a real English game-guide site, so readers find a topic in the FIRST viewport. Layout dramatically different from the familiar left-text/right-image hero. A compact 72px top navigation with End of Abyss brand and Guides Weapons Return notes Platforms dropdowns, plus theme button. Under it a 210px high horizontal panoramic strip uses actual End of Abyss combat scene cropped as a widescreen frame. The title End of Abyss in confident geometric condensed type sits at its left edge, one understated line 'Doors, weapons and return routes.' at the right. No massive poster title, no blank fullscreen intro. Then the main region is a sophisticated continuous directory: six full-width readable rows, each left main title, center one-line player question summary and right arrow. Rows are not cards. Exact labels: Energy node door will not open; Scanner and door requirements; Find a missing weapon; Save pods, death and supplies; Map and backtracking; Completion checklist. The FIRST row has a broad flat orange field with dark text: this is an actual selected or focused guide treatment, not a badge. Remaining rows near-black, white titles, generous horizontal rhythm, simple boundaries rather than glowing borders. One supporting thumbnail is the actual blue bridge scene aligned to a selected row as a quiet visual preview; don't repeat six unrelated generated pictures. Bottom opening region at y750 uses a pale white reading field with title 'What is keeping the door shut?', short calm explanation, labeled Door symptom dropdown 'Choose a symptom' and a direct Return notebook link at the right. Display 56-80px, entry titles 24-30px, body 17px. No eyebrow/kicker labels anywhere; no top-small-title headers, no section numbers, no fake film perforations, fake in-game terminal, fake map/coordinates, monochrome text costume, empty cards, generic SaaS structure. Motion implied only by a focus marker transferring along directory rows, never horizontal scrolling to reach a topic. Exact supplied images are real game art; use their image identity, don't paint new fictional evidence. A highly original, perfectly aligned and readable reference page, not a cover poster or photographed physical object.
note: Concept only; site implementation keeps actual source copy and original official game artwork.
